title: 138-case Job Portal checklist
idConvention: Original section.case position; no global renumbering

cases.title: Homepage loads
cases.expected: Open http://127.0.0.1:5175. Real job listings should appear.

cases.title: Search bar
cases.expected: Enter a job title and press Enter. Listings should update.

cases.title: Navigation links
cases.expected: Click each visible header link and verify its destination.

cases.title: Job cards
cases.expected: Click a job card. Its details page should open.

cases.title: Missing job handling
cases.expected: Open an invalid job URL. A not-found/recovery view should appear.

cases.title: Refresh and back navigation
cases.expected: Refresh pages and use browser Back without losing navigation.

cases.title: Clerk login
cases.expected: Sign in using an authorized Clerk development account.

cases.title: First-time account creation
cases.expected: A new candidate profile should initialize automatically.

cases.title: Session persistence
cases.expected: Refresh the page. The session should remain active.

cases.title: Account menu
cases.expected: Open the Clerk account menu and check available actions.

cases.title: Logout
cases.expected: Sign out. Candidate-only pages should require login again.

cases.title: Browse all jobs
cases.expected: Verify visible jobs load from MongoDB.

cases.title: Search by title
cases.expected: Search for a known job title.

cases.title: Search by location
cases.expected: Search for a known job location.

cases.title: Category filter
cases.expected: Select a category and verify the results.

cases.title: Salary filter
cases.expected: Apply a salary range and verify results.

cases.title: Experience or level
cases.expected: Apply an experience/level filter.

cases.title: Job type
cases.expected: Apply a job-type filter.

cases.title: Work mode
cases.expected: Test remote, hybrid or on-site where available.

cases.title: Multiple filters
cases.expected: Combine filters and verify the intersection.

cases.title: Hide applied jobs
cases.expected: After applying, hide applied jobs from results.

cases.title: Clear filters
cases.expected: Click Clear. All search/filter selections should reset.

cases.title: Filters after refresh
cases.expected: Refresh and verify filter behavior remains correct.

cases.title: Hidden job security
cases.expected: Hide a test job and verify its public URL is inaccessible.

cases.title: No-resume state
cases.expected: Open Applied Jobs without a resume. An upload prompt should appear.

cases.title: Valid PDF upload
cases.expected: Upload a valid PDF of 5 MB or less.

cases.title: Immediate extracted skills
cases.expected: For the provided fixture, React, Node.js and MongoDB should appear immediately.

cases.title: Experience hint
cases.expected: The fixture's two-year experience mention should appear as a hint.

cases.title: Refresh persistence
cases.expected: Refresh and verify extracted skills remain.

cases.title: Invalid file type
cases.expected: Try a non-PDF file. It should be rejected.

cases.title: Oversized PDF
cases.expected: Try a PDF over 5 MB. It should be rejected.

cases.title: Damaged PDF
cases.expected: Try a corrupted test PDF. It should be rejected.

cases.title: Manual skills separation
cases.expected: Clear manually entered skills; PDF-extracted skills should still appear.

cases.title: Own resume access
cases.expected: Open your own resume through the authorized download flow.

cases.title: Career hub
cases.expected: Open /career and find resume analysis/matching.

cases.title: Compare skills
cases.expected: Choose Compare skills and find matching jobs.

cases.title: Recognized skills
cases.expected: Verify matched skills correspond to the resume and job.

cases.title: Missing skills
cases.expected: Verify missing job-required skills are displayed.

cases.title: Coverage calculation
cases.expected: Fixture with three of four required skills should show 75% coverage.

cases.title: Experience information
cases.expected: Verify experience is presented as a hint, not verified history.

cases.title: Suggestions
cases.expected: Verify supported improvement suggestions appear.

cases.title: No recognized skills
cases.expected: Use a text PDF without recognized skills; expect an honest fallback.

cases.title: Exclude applied jobs
cases.expected: Applied jobs should not appear among unapplied recommendations.

cases.title: Matching score meaning
cases.expected: Score should describe skill coverage, not hiring probability.

cases.title: Profile page
cases.expected: Open Career hub → Profile.

cases.title: Skills
cases.expected: Add/edit manual skills and save.

cases.title: Education
cases.expected: Enter education and save.

cases.title: Experience
cases.expected: Enter experience and save.

cases.title: GitHub
cases.expected: Save a valid GitHub profile URL.

cases.title: LinkedIn
cases.expected: Save a valid LinkedIn profile URL.

cases.title: Portfolio
cases.expected: Save a valid portfolio URL.

cases.title: Refresh persistence
cases.expected: Refresh and verify saved profile data.

cases.title: Invalid professional URL
cases.expected: Invalid GitHub/LinkedIn hosts should be rejected.

cases.title: Identity protection
cases.expected: Clerk-managed identity fields should not be editable through profile API.

cases.title: Save job
cases.expected: Save a visible test job.

cases.title: Saved jobs list
cases.expected: Open Career hub → Saved jobs and verify it appears.

cases.title: Refresh
cases.expected: Refresh and verify the job remains saved.

cases.title: Duplicate protection
cases.expected: Saving twice should not create duplicates.

cases.title: Remove saved job
cases.expected: Remove it and verify disappearance.

cases.title: Account isolation
cases.expected: Another candidate should not see your saved jobs.

cases.title: Apply without resume
cases.expected: A candidate without a resume should be directed to upload.

cases.title: Apply with resume
cases.expected: Submit an application for a visible job.

cases.title: Success feedback
cases.expected: The job should display Already Applied.

cases.title: Applications page
cases.expected: Verify the application appears under /applications.

cases.title: Initial status
cases.expected: Verify the application initially shows Pending.

cases.title: Duplicate prevention
cases.expected: Repeated submission should be rejected (HTTP 409 at API).

cases.title: Hide applied
cases.expected: Verify Hide applied excludes the job.

cases.title: Application persistence
cases.expected: Refresh and verify the application remains.

cases.title: Hidden job restriction
cases.expected: A hidden job should reject new public applications.

cases.title: Pending status
cases.expected: New application should show Pending.

cases.title: Accepted status
cases.expected: Recruiter changes status to Accepted; candidate sees it.

cases.title: Rejected status
cases.expected: Recruiter changes a test application to Rejected; candidate sees it.

cases.title: Manual refresh
cases.expected: Click Refresh applications and verify status.

cases.title: Window focus
cases.expected: Return focus to the tab; status should refresh.

cases.title: Periodic refresh
cases.expected: Wait up to 30 seconds for an updated status.

cases.title: Persistence
cases.expected: Refresh and verify status remains correct.

cases.title: Recruiter registration
cases.expected: Register using Recruiter Login → Sign up.

cases.title: Company logo
cases.expected: Upload a valid PNG, JPEG or WebP logo.

cases.title: Invalid logo
cases.expected: Unsupported/oversized logos should show errors.

cases.title: Login
cases.expected: Sign in using recruiter credentials.

cases.title: Incorrect password
cases.expected: Wrong password should produce a safe error.

cases.title: Dashboard protection
cases.expected: Signed-out users should not access recruiter dashboard.

cases.title: Modal keyboard access
cases.expected: Test Tab, Escape and focus restoration.

cases.title: Logout
cases.expected: Sign out and verify dashboard access is removed.

cases.title: Add Job page
cases.expected: Open Dashboard → Add Job.

cases.title: Create job
cases.expected: Post a valid Demo Full Stack Developer job.

cases.title: Required validation
cases.expected: Missing required fields should show validation errors.

cases.title: Manage Jobs
cases.expected: Confirm the new job appears in Manage Jobs.

cases.title: Edit job
cases.expected: Change salary/description and save.

cases.title: Refresh edit
cases.expected: Refresh and verify edited values persist.

cases.title: Hide job
cases.expected: Hide the job and verify it disappears publicly.

cases.title: Hidden detail
cases.expected: Public job details should not expose hidden jobs.

cases.title: Restore job
cases.expected: Restore visibility and verify public listing returns.

cases.title: Recruiter ownership
cases.expected: Another recruiter should not be able to edit the job.

cases.title: View Applications
cases.expected: Open Dashboard → View Applications.

cases.title: Applicant listing
cases.expected: Verify the candidate appears under the correct job.

cases.title: Candidate details
cases.expected: Verify only permitted applicant information is shown.

cases.title: Resume download
cases.expected: Use Get resume link → Open resume to retrieve the private PDF.

cases.title: Change status
cases.expected: Change Pending to Accepted or Rejected.

cases.title: Status persistence
cases.expected: Refresh and verify the new status.

cases.title: Candidate synchronization
cases.expected: Candidate account should display updated status.

cases.title: Other recruiter restriction
cases.expected: Another recruiter should not access or modify the application.

cases.title: Schedule interview
cases.expected: Select an applicant and schedule a future interview.

cases.title: Date and time
cases.expected: Enter a valid future local date/time.

cases.title: Meeting details
cases.expected: Enter supported interview details.

cases.title: Save
cases.expected: Save and verify the interview is attached to the application.

cases.title: Candidate visibility
cases.expected: Candidate should see the interview in Applied Jobs.

cases.title: Update interview
cases.expected: Edit the schedule and save.

cases.title: Updated candidate view
cases.expected: Candidate should see updated details.

cases.title: Timezone
cases.expected: Displayed date/time should be correct for the browser timezone.

cases.title: Privacy
cases.expected: Unrelated accounts should not access the interview.

cases.title: Analytics page
cases.expected: Open Dashboard → Analytics.

cases.title: Job count
cases.expected: Compare total jobs with actual owned jobs.

cases.title: Application count
cases.expected: Compare total applications with actual records.

cases.title: Status counts
cases.expected: Verify Pending, Accepted and Rejected counts.

cases.title: Applications-per-job chart
cases.expected: Chart values should match database records.

cases.title: Empty state
cases.expected: New recruiter with no jobs should see a useful empty state.

cases.title: Ownership
cases.expected: Other recruiters' data should not appear.

cases.title: Candidate protected routes
cases.expected: Signed-out users should be redirected from private candidate pages.

cases.title: Recruiter protected routes
cases.expected: Signed-out users should be blocked from dashboard routes.

cases.title: Private resumes
cases.expected: Unauthorized accounts should not access another candidate's resume.

cases.title: Missing routes
cases.expected: Unknown UI routes should provide recovery/navigation.

cases.title: API error recovery
cases.expected: Temporary API failure should show Retry and recover.

cases.title: Database restart persistence
cases.expected: Gracefully restart backend and verify records remain.

cases.title: Console errors
cases.expected: Check DevTools for unexpected JavaScript errors.

cases.title: Network failures
cases.expected: Check DevTools Network for unexpected failed requests.

cases.title: Mobile homepage
cases.expected: Check layout at approximately 390px width.

cases.title: Mobile navigation
cases.expected: Verify menus and navigation work.

cases.title: Mobile job filters
cases.expected: Test search and filtering on mobile.

cases.title: Mobile resume analysis
cases.expected: Upload a PDF and inspect extracted skills on mobile.

cases.title: Mobile applications
cases.expected: Verify application cards and statuses fit the screen.

cases.title: Mobile recruiter dashboard
cases.expected: Verify dashboard controls are usable.

cases.title: Mobile analytics
cases.expected: Verify charts are readable without horizontal overflow.

cases.title: Tablet layout
cases.expected: Repeat representative flows at approximately 820px width.

cases.title: Candidate demonstration
cases.expected: Login → Search → Filter → Upload → Analyze → Match → Save → Apply → Track → Interview → Logout.

cases.title: Recruiter demonstration
cases.expected: Register/Login → Add Job → Edit → Visibility → Applicants → Resume → Status → Interview → Analytics → Logout.

cases.title: Cross-account workflow
cases.expected: Use separate candidate/recruiter browser sessions and verify shared application updates.

cases.title: Final verification
cases.expected: Record any failures with page, action, error and expected result.
